resources.string: Long-press a session to select it, then tap more rows. Pin, mute or unmute, archive, mark read or unread or delete them together; rename when only one is selected. Back leaves the selection. Unread marks stay on this device.
A session is long-pressed; two rows are selected and the menu deletes them after one confirmation.

Turn on Hide keyboard after sending in Settings → Message box: once a message is sent, the keyboard closes so you can read the answer as it streams. Tap the message box to type again. If sending fails, the text and the keyboard stay.
A prompt is typed and sent; the keyboard slides away and the answer streams in over the whole chat.
The test **ParserTest** expects a trailing newline. I added it to `fixtures/input.txt` and the build passes again.
Lock the app with your face or fingerprint

Turn on App lock in Settings → Security: OpenCode asks for your face, a fingerprint or the device passcode before showing your sessions. Choose when it asks again, when you leave the app and when you turn the screen off, right away or after some minutes. On trusted Wi-Fi networks, or with the server on your local network, it opens without asking.
The app comes back locked; Unlock opens the system prompt and a fingerprint shows the sessions again.
